items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I got to know Lew Grade and Leslie, and Delfonte, who's a big man. In fact I think Delfonte was kind of responsible for my going over the first time, through an agent... But anyway, Delfonte is a brother to the Grades.

ctx.x: Now, what I'd do, I'd work six days in one place and on Sundays we'd come to London and do -- I think they called it variety. They called it variety there. I think that's the name they called it, variety. Variety houses and variety concerts. But it was really variety, because you know

it was just something like our vaudeville shows here that we used to have, where they had comedians, you know, and dancers and singers and just all sorts of acts on the show, you know. It was just marvelous.

But it was a marvelous experience, and I got to know Lew Grade and Leslie, and Delfonte, who's a big man. In fact I think Delfonte was kind of responsible for my going over the first time, through an agent, Mumford, I think this guy's name was, Mumford. I think that's his name. I hope I remember the name correctly.
